1_turret7.runs: r4a 23/2 (apc_rear_gun: rear 0, other guns 0; muzzle_on_foe_side cos -1.00), r4b 25/0, r4c 25/0, r4d 25/0, r4e 24/1 (first_shot_a_popup_turret: swung 83 of 89 deg, 6.0 deg off, under concurrent headless test load), r4f 25/0 (after the popup oracle fix, under load)
1_turret7.popup_cause: oracle sampling, not sim: the flow read each shooter's target once per frame (tpos); a slow frame holds several sim ticks, so the target it compared the lay against could be a foe other than the one the mount actually laid on and shot (sim traverse7.lay enforces 5 deg). Fix: tools/pt7_turret7.gd records each shooter's first ShotFired target (mv.world_events, tick exact) and measures off-target against it; prints 'first_shot_target' when the frame-read target differs. Check thresholds unchanged.
1_turret7.apc_rear_cause: NOT FOUND (could not reproduce in 5 more runs). Two modes seen: r2a 'other guns 200' (front pod took every shot) and r4a 'other guns 0' (no drawn APC shot at all). Leading hypothesis for mode a: apc_gun7.on_shot picks the gun with the DRAWN hull face (s.face = motion out_face), the flow forces sim facing 0 with ae.facing = 0.0 directly; if the drawn face lags/differs (APC moved briefly after spawn_team), the front pod 'bears' and the rear is blind -> front takes all. Check motion.gd step() S_FACE vs sim facing for a stationary vehicle whose facing was written directly. Mode b unexplained.
1_turret7.diag_added: tools/pt7_turret7.gd prints 'apc_rear_diag' (sim fires counted from cd_ticks restarts vs drawn apc shots, order, target, moving, cd, foe alive/hp/dist, gun state seen/face, fx muzzle7 counters) only when rear == 0 or front > 0; 'apc_front_shot' kept.
1_turret7.open: run turret7 until apc_rear_gun fails again, read apc_rear_diag, fix at the cause; then 3 consecutive green runs (r4d, r4e(apc part ok), r4f were green but the popup fix landed between r4e and r4f, so only r4f counts on the final tree)

2_muzzle7.stage9_cause: the run's first click (_pick_option, 1.5 s after start) sometimes produced no popup (log: ok=false items=4 with no pick_option_miss print = popup not visible after the click). Fix: tools/ui_playtest.gd _pick_option clicks the OptionButton up to 3 times until its popup shows (prints PLAYTEST-DBG pick_option_no_popup per retry). The item is still picked by a real click.
2_muzzle7.apc_both_guns_cause: flow loop stop condition: the APC loop ended after 5 screenshots; in r3b the RWS and the rear pods used them (rear 6, RWS 7) before the front pod fired -> front 0. Across runs the front pod fires (a: 102, r2a: 26, r3a: 1, r3c: 29). Fix: tools/pt7_muzzle7.gd keeps looping (<= 40 s as before) until front, rear and RWS have each fired; a gun kind's first flash may take a 6th+ screenshot. Check unchanged.
2_muzzle7.result_before: muzzle7_r3c 20/1 (g6_slot0_stage9_click); muzzle7_r3b 18/3 incl apc_both_guns front pod 0
2_muzzle7.result_after: NOT RUN windowed (budget). pt7_muzzle7.gd parse-checked headless only.

3_cnops7_xp.cause: two parts. (a) real bug in sim/systems/cn_progress7.gd: kill credit came only from st.hits sampled every 10 ticks (_sample_hits); an enemy dropped within a few ticks of its first hit (WOUND7 zone kills, uncommitted wounds/combat work) was never credited to anyone. (b) test setup: the rifleman spawned 3 tiles from the dismounted team was shot dead by team mate op 49 at tick 4, so the staged kill never happened (probe: Damage 41/45/49 then EntityDestroyed at t4).
3_cnops7_xp.fix: cn_progress7._events: a 'Damage' event whose shooter is a registered CN team member/APC records st.hits[target] = shooter at once (enemy targets only; only runs when CN state exists). tests/test_cnops7.gd: team holds fire (cd_ticks NOFIRE) while the veteran kill is staged (check unchanged); new test_quick_kill_credited_to_the_shooter (fails without the fix: got 0, expected 1 - A/B done).
3_cnops7_xp.result_before: RESULT pass=9 fail=1 (kill credited to the operator got 0)
